tool_input.prompt:
You are building the Setup Guide Checklist system for IsaFlow (PRD-2026-04-003, WS-A1).

## Context
- IsaFlow is a Next.js accounting app, Tailwind CSS, teal accent, dark mode via `class` strategy
- Shared UI components exist at `src/components/ui/` — use them: Button, Drawer, ProgressBar, Badge, Card from `@/components/ui`
- The app layout is at `src/components/layout/AppLayout.tsx` — it has a header bar with icons
- Auth context: `useAuth()` from `@/contexts/AuthContext` gives `{ user }`
- Company context: `useCompany()` from `@/contexts/CompanyContext` gives `{ company }`
- API pattern: use `apiFetch` from `@/lib/apiFetch` for API calls
- User preferences API exists at `/api/auth/preferences` (GET/POST key-value pairs)

## What to Build

### 1. Setup Guide Data (`src/components/onboarding/setupGuideConfig.ts`)
Define the 9 setup categories with their sub-tasks:

```typescript
interface SetupTask {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  description: string;
  href: string; // page to navigate to
  autoDetectKey?: string; // key to check for auto-completion
}

interface SetupCategory {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  description: string;
  icon: LucideIcon;
  tasks: SetupTask[];
}
```

Categories:
1. **Welcome** — Watch intro video, Explore demo company
2. **Company Details** — Add logo, Set legal name & registration, Add address & banking details
3. **Financial Setup** — Review chart of accounts, Set fiscal year, Enter opening balances
4. **VAT Configuration** — Set VAT registration number, Configure tax rates
5. **Connect Bank** — Add bank account, Import first statement, Set up bank feed
6. **Create First Invoice** — Set up invoice template, Create and send first invoice
7. **Add Contacts** — Import or create first customer, Import or create first supplier
8. **Explore Reports** — View Income Statement, View Balance Sheet
9. **Invite Team** — Add a user, Set permissions

### 2. Setup Guide Drawer (`src/components/onboarding/SetupGuideDrawer.tsx`)
A right-side drawer (use the shared Drawer component) that shows:
- Overall progress bar at top (X of Y tasks completed, with ProgressBar component)
- Collapsible category sections (click to expand/collapse)
- Each category shows: icon, label, progress fraction (e.g., "2 of 3"), expand arrow
- Expanded category shows its tasks as a checklist:
  - Green checkmark for completed tasks
  - Empty circle for incomplete tasks
  - Task label is a link to the relevant page
  - Task description as small gray text
- "Mark as done" button next to each incomplete task (for manual completion)
- Auto-completion: check against company data (has logo? has bank account? has invoice? etc.)

### 3. Setup Guide Button (`src/components/onboarding/SetupGuideButton.tsx`)
A button/icon for the header bar that:
- Shows a checkmark icon (CheckSquare from lucide-react)
- Shows a small badge with remaining task count (e.g., "7")
- Clicking opens the SetupGuideDrawer
- Pulses/animates subtly for new users (first 3 days)

### 4. API Route (`pages/api/accounting/setup-guide.ts`)
GET endpoint that returns completion status for all auto-detectable tasks:
- Check if company has a logo (company_logo is not null)
- Check if company has bank accounts (count from bank_accounts table)
- Check if company has invoices (count from customer_invoices table)
- Check if company has customers (count from customers table)
- Check if company has suppliers (count from suppliers table)
- Check opening balances exist
- Check fiscal periods exist
- Returns: `{ completedTasks: string[] }` — list of completed task IDs

Use the standard withCompany/withErrorHandler pattern. Check existing API routes for the pattern — read one like `pages/api/accounting/dashboard-stats.ts` to match.

### 5. Integration
- Add the SetupGuideButton to `AppLayout.tsx` header — next to the existing icons (search, nav toggle, theme toggle)
- Store manual task completions in user_preferences via the existing preferences API
- The drawer should combine auto-detected completions (from the API) with manual completions (from preferences)

## Important Rules
- Use shared UI components (Drawer, ProgressBar, Badge, Button, Card)
- Strict TypeScript, no `any`
- Max 300 lines per file
- Dark mode support
- Check existing patterns before coding — read AppLayout.tsx, an API route, and the preferences API first
- Do NOT modify any existing components except AppLayout.tsx (to add the SetupGuideButton)

- The header currently has: Logo, CompanySwitcher, Search (Ctrl+K), NavModeToggle, ThemeToggle, User name, Logout

### 1. CreateNewMenu Component (`src/components/layout/CreateNewMenu.tsx`)
A "+" button in the header that opens a dropdown menu with quick-create options:

**Menu items:**
| Label | Icon | Route |
|-------|------|-------|
| New Invoice | FileText | /accounting/customer-invoices?action=new |
| New Bill | Receipt | /accounting/supplier-invoices?action=new |
| New Quote | FileCheck | /accounting/customer-quotes?action=new |
| Record Payment | CreditCard | /accounting/customer-payments/new |
| New Journal Entry | BookOpen | /accounting/journal-entries/new |
| New Contact | UserPlus | /accounting/customers/new |
| Bank Transfer | ArrowLeftRight | /accounting/bank-transfers?action=new |

**Behavior:**
- "+" button (Plus icon from lucide-react) with teal background, rounded full
- Click opens a dropdown menu below the button
- Each menu item has: icon (left), label, optional keyboard shortcut hint (right, gray text)
- Keyboard shortcut: `N` key opens the menu (when not in an input), then first letter selects (e.g., `N` then `I` = New Invoice)
- Click outside closes the dropdown
- ESC closes the dropdown
- Menu has a subtle shadow and rounded corners
- Dark mode support

### 2. Keyboard Shortcut Integration
- Register the `N` key as a global shortcut (only when not focused on an input/textarea)
- When `N` is pressed, open the menu
- When menu is open, pressing a letter key focuses/activates the matching item:
  - `I` = Invoice, `B` = Bill, `Q` = Quote, `P` = Payment, `J` = Journal, `C` = Contact, `T` = Transfer
- Show these shortcuts as hints in the menu (e.g., "N then I" shown as small gray text)

### 3. Integration into AppLayout
- Read `src/components/layout/AppLayout.tsx` first to understand the header structure
- Add the CreateNewMenu to the header bar, positioned BEFORE the search button (so the order is: Logo, CompanySwitcher, **[+]**, Search, NavToggle, ThemeToggle, User, Logout)
- The "+" button should be visually prominent but not overwhelming — teal bg, white plus icon, w-8 h-8 rounded-full

## Important Rules
- Use shared UI components where possible (Button for the trigger, Tooltip for hints)
- Strict TypeScript, no `any`
- Max 300 lines per file
- Dark mode support
- Proper keyboard navigation (arrow keys in dropdown, enter to select)
- Use `useRouter` from Next.js for navigation
- Read AppLayout.tsx carefully before modifying it — make minimal changes
- Use portal rendering for the dropdown to avoid z-index issues

You are building First-Use Contextual Wizards and Invoice Preview for IsaFlow (PRD-2026-04-003, WS-A3 + WS-E1).

## Context
- Next.js app, Tailwind CSS, teal accent, dark mode via `class` strategy
- Shared UI: Modal, Button, Input, Card, Badge, ProgressBar from `@/components/ui`
- Auth: `useAuth()` from `@/contexts/AuthContext`
- Preferences API at `/api/auth/preferences` — GET/POST key-value pairs per user
- `apiFetch` from `@/lib/apiFetch`

## Part 1: First-Use Contextual Wizards (WS-A3)

### A. First Invoice Wizard (`src/components/onboarding/FirstInvoiceWizard.tsx`)
A modal that appears when a user navigates to the invoice creation page for the first time. Shows:

**Step 1: Company Branding**
- Upload company logo (drag & drop zone)
- Company name (pre-filled from company settings)
- Shows live invoice preview on the right side (a simplified visual of how the invoice header will look)

**Step 2: Payment Details**
- Bank name, account number, branch code fields
- Payment terms textarea (e.g., "Payment due within 30 days")
- This info will appear on invoices

**Step 3: Invoice Numbering**
- Prefix field (e.g., "INV-")
- Next number field (e.g., "0001")
- Preview of full invoice number: "INV-0001"

**Behavior:**
- 3 steps with step indicator (dots or numbered)
- Back/Next/Finish buttons
- "Skip for now" link at the bottom
- Dismissed permanently when completed or skipped — stored in user_preferences key `first_invoice_wizard_dismissed`
- Re-triggerable from settings (check for a `wizard_reset` preference key)
- Max 250 lines — keep it focused

### B. First Contact Wizard (`src/components/onboarding/FirstContactWizard.tsx`)
Simpler modal for first-time contact creation:

- Brief explainer: "Contacts are your customers and suppliers"
- Two cards: "I want to create a Customer" / "I want to create a Supplier" — clicking navigates to the right form
- "Import from CSV" link
- "Don't show again" checkbox
- Stored in user_preferences key `first_contact_wizard_dismissed`
- Max 150 lines

### C. First Bank Import Wizard (`src/components/onboarding/FirstBankImportWizard.tsx`)
Modal for first bank statement import:

- Supported formats: CSV, OFX, QIF
- Column mapping guidance (date, description, amount)
- "Download sample CSV" link
- Tips: "Make sure your statement has headers", "Date format should be DD/MM/YYYY"
- "Got it" button dismisses
- Stored in user_preferences key `first_bank_import_wizard_dismissed`
- Max 150 lines

### D. Wizard Hook (`src/hooks/useFirstUseWizard.ts`)
A reusable hook:
```typescript
function useFirstUseWizard(wizardKey: string): {
  shouldShow: boolean;
  dismiss: () => void;
  loading: boolean;
}
```
- Checks user_preferences for `{wizardKey}_dismissed`
- Returns `shouldShow: true` if not dismissed
- `dismiss()` saves the preference
- Cache the result so it doesn't re-fetch on every render

## Part 2: Invoice Preview (WS-E1)

### InvoicePreviewModal (`src/components/accounting/InvoicePreviewModal.tsx`)
A modal that shows a PDF-like preview of an invoice:

- Props: `invoice` object with all invoice fields (or just the ID to fetch)
- Renders a clean, print-ready invoice layout inside the modal:
  - Company logo & name (top left)
  - "INVOICE" heading (top right)
  - Invoice number, date, due date
  - Bill-to: customer name & address
  - Line items table: Description, Qty, Unit Price, Amount
  - Subtotal, VAT, Total
  - Payment terms/bank details at bottom
- Modal size: `xl` or `full`
- "Send from here" button and "Download PDF" button in footer
- Use the shared Modal component
- Max 250 lines

## Important Rules
- Use shared UI components (Modal, Button, Input, Card, ProgressBar)
- Strict TypeScript, no `any`
- Max lines per file as specified above
- Dark mode support
- Read existing patterns: check `src/components/onboarding/WizardSteps.tsx` for existing wizard patterns
- Check how preferences API works before coding the hook
- DO NOT modify existing pages — just export the components. Integration will happen separately.

You are building Combined Action Buttons and Contextual Settings Links for IsaFlow (PRD-2026-04-003, WS-E2 + WS-D2).

## Context
- Next.js app, Tailwind CSS, teal accent, dark mode
- Shared UI: Button, Badge, Tooltip from `@/components/ui`
- Navigation config is at `src/components/accounting/accountingNavConfig.ts`
- The nav renders via `src/components/layout/ModuleNav.tsx`

## Part 1: Combined Action Buttons (WS-E2)

### SplitButton Component (`src/components/ui/SplitButton.tsx`)
A split button with a primary action and a dropdown of secondary actions (like Xero's "Approve & email"):

```typescript
interface SplitButtonProps {
  label: string;
  onClick: () => void;
  variant?: 'primary' | 'secondary' | 'danger';
  size?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg';
  disabled?: boolean;
  loading?: boolean;
  options: Array<{
    label: string;
    onClick: () => void;
    icon?: LucideIcon;
    disabled?: boolean;
  }>;
}
```

**Design:**
- Main button on the left with the primary action label
- Small dropdown arrow button on the right (separated by a thin border)
- Clicking the arrow opens a dropdown menu below
- Dropdown has the secondary options listed
- Click outside or ESC closes dropdown
- Keyboard: Enter on main button triggers primary action, arrow keys in dropdown
- Dark mode support
- Max 200 lines

### Add to UI barrel (`src/components/ui/index.ts`)
Export SplitButton from the barrel file.

## Part 2: Contextual Settings Links (WS-D2)

### Update Navigation Config (`src/components/accounting/accountingNavConfig.ts`)

Read the current nav config file first. Then add a settings link to each relevant nav section's flyout menu:

Add to the **Customers** tab flyout:
- Separator line, then "Customer Settings" link → `/accounting/company-settings?tab=documents`

Add to the **Suppliers** tab flyout:
- Separator line, then "Supplier Settings" link → `/accounting/company-settings?tab=documents`

Add to the **Banking** tab flyout:
- Separator line, then "Banking Settings" link → `/accounting/company-settings?tab=general`

Add to the **VAT** tab flyout:
- Separator line, then "VAT Settings" link → `/accounting/company-settings?tab=vat`

Add to the **Accounts** tab flyout:
- Separator line, then "Accounting Settings" link → `/accounting/accounting-settings`

**Implementation notes:**
- Read the nav config structure first to understand how items are defined
- Settings links should have a gear/cog icon (Settings from lucide-react)
- They should be visually separated from the other items (border-top or different background)
- Check how the nav config defines sections — some use `section` labels, others are flat arrays
- The nav config likely has a structure like `{ label, href, icon, children? }` — match it exactly

## Important Rules
- Strict TypeScript, no `any`
- Max lines per file as specified
- Dark mode support
- Read existing files FIRST before modifying
- For the nav config: make minimal changes, just add the settings items
- SplitButton should use portal for dropdown (avoid z-index issues)

tool_input.prompt:
You are building the Report Favouriting system for IsaFlow (PRD-2026-04-003, WS-G1).

## Context
- Next.js app, Tailwind CSS, teal accent, dark mode
- Shared UI: Button, Badge, Card from `@/components/ui`
- The reports hub page is at `pages/accounting/reports/index.tsx`
- User preferences API at `/api/auth/preferences` (GET/POST key-value)
- `apiFetch` from `@/lib/apiFetch`
- Auth: `useAuth()` from `@/contexts/AuthContext`

## What to Build

### 1. Report Favourites Hook (`src/hooks/useReportFavourites.ts`)
A hook that manages favourite reports per user:

```typescript
function useReportFavourites(): {
  favourites: string[];      // array of report IDs
  isFavourite: (id: string) => boolean;
  toggleFavourite: (id: string) => void;
  loading: boolean;
}
```

- Loads favourite report IDs from user_preferences (key: `report_favourites`)
- `toggleFavourite` adds/removes from the list and saves via preferences API
- Optimistic update — toggle immediately, revert on error
- Cache with `useState` so it doesn't refetch every render

### 2. FavouriteButton Component (`src/components/accounting/reports/FavouriteButton.tsx`)
A small star icon button:
- Props: `reportId: string`, uses the `useReportFavourites` hook
- Filled yellow star when favourited, outline star when not
- Click toggles favourite state
- Tooltip: "Add to favourites" / "Remove from favourites"
- Uses Star icon from lucide-react
- Small, inline — designed to sit next to a report title
- Max 60 lines

### 3. Update Reports Hub Page (`pages/accounting/reports/index.tsx`)
Read the current reports page first. Then:

1. Add a "Favourites" section at the TOP of the page (before other report categories):
   - Only shows if user has at least 1 favourite
   - Heading: "Favourites" with a star icon
   - Lists favourited reports as clickable cards/links
   - Each has a filled star button to unfavourite

2. Add a FavouriteButton (outline star) next to each report name in the existing report list sections

3. Add a "Show descriptions" toggle (like Xero's):
   - Toggle button in the page header area
   - When on: shows a brief description under each report name
   - When off: just shows report names (more compact)
   - State saved in user_preferences (key: `report_show_descriptions`)
   - Default: off

## Report Descriptions
Add descriptions for the main reports. Define them in a constant map:

```typescript
const REPORT_DESCRIPTIONS: Record<string, string> = {
  'income-statement': 'Revenue and expenses for a selected period',
  'balance-sheet': 'Assets, liabilities, and equity at a point in time',
  'cash-flow': 'Cash movements from operating, investing, and financing activities',
  'trial-balance': 'All account balances in debit and credit columns',
  'general-ledger': 'Detailed transaction history for all accounts',
  'budget-vs-actual': 'Compare budgeted vs actual figures with variance analysis',
  'vat-return': 'VAT201 return calculation for SARS submission',
  'ar-aging': 'Outstanding customer invoices by age bucket',
  'ap-aging': 'Outstanding supplier invoices by age bucket',
  // ... add for all reports on the page
};
```

## Important Rules
- Strict TypeScript, no `any`
- Max 300 lines per file
- Dark mode support
- Read the existing reports page structure FIRST before modifying
- Use the shared UI components (Button, Card, Badge)
- Use the Star and StarOff icons from lucide-react
- Keep changes to the reports page minimal — add the favourites section and star buttons, don't restructure the whole page
- The Tooltip component from `@/components/ui` should be used on the star buttons

## Code Review Report — Phase 3 (PRD-2026-04-003)

### Fixes Applied

**1. CRITICAL: Dynamic Tailwind classes purged at build time** (`pages/accounting/reports/index.tsx`)
- `ReportItem` used template literals like `` bg-${report.color}-500/10 `` which Tailwind cannot detect at build time
- Added a `COLOR_CLASSES` map with full static class strings covering all 11 colors used by reports
- Used `cn()` utility to apply them

**2. SSR crash + memory leak: module-level `URL.createObjectURL`** (`src/components/onboarding/FirstBankImportWizard.tsx`)
- `new Blob()` and `URL.createObjectURL()` were called at module scope, which fails during SSR and leaks the object URL (never revoked)
- Moved into `useEffect` with proper `URL.revokeObjectURL` cleanup on unmount
- Removed unused `useRef` import

**3. Dead code in FirstContactWizard** (`src/components/onboarding/FirstContactWizard.tsx`)
- `handleGotIt` had `if (dontShow) dismiss(); else dismiss();` -- both branches identical
- Simplified to just `dismiss()`

### Verified OK (No Changes Needed)

- **TypeScript quality**: No `any` types anywhere. All hooks, props, and state are properly typed.
- **Preferences API**: Both `useFirstUseWizard` and `useReportFavourites` correctly use `PUT /api/auth/preferences` with `{ preferences: { key: value } }` shape.
- **SplitButton**: Uses `createPortal(... document.body)` for dropdown. Has full keyboard nav (Arrow keys, Escape, Enter), `aria-haspopup`, `aria-expanded`, `aria-label`, `role="menu"`, `role="menuitem"`. Dark mode classes present everywhere.
- **SplitButton exported**: Confirmed in `src/components/ui/index.ts` line 48-49.
- **Nav config**: Structure is unchanged. Settings sections render inline with gear icon and separator. `getActiveTabId` routing logic is unaffected.
- **Modal/Button usage**: All wizards correctly use `Modal`, `Modal.Body`, `Modal.Footer`, `Button` from shared UI. `InvoicePreviewModal` correctly uses `leftIcon` prop.
- **Dark mode**: All components have `dark:` variants on every visual element.
- **Accessibility**: FavouriteButton has `aria-label`, `aria-pressed`. SplitButton has full ARIA menu pattern. Wizards use proper form labels.
- **File sizes**: All files under 300 lines. (ModuleNav is 357 and navConfig is 660, but these are pre-existing and data-heavy.)

### Architecture Note (Not Fixed)

- Each `FavouriteButton` instance creates its own `useReportFavourites` hook, meaning the reports page fires N+1 preference fetches (1 from the page + 1 per button). In practice the `loaded.current` ref prevents double-fetch within each instance, but N instances still make N calls. A React context provider would fix this. Low priority since preferences are small and cached.

### Quality Score: **8/10**

Solid implementation. The dynamic Tailwind issue was the only real production bug. Everything else follows project patterns well -- proper `cn()` usage, consistent `apiFetch` with correct response unwrapping, dark mode coverage, accessibility attributes, and shared UI component reuse.

#!/bin/bash
# Deploy IsaFlow App to Velocity Server (standalone build)
set -e

DEPLOY_DIR="/home/velo/isaflow"
REPO_DIR="/home/hein/Workspace/IsaFlow"
SERVICE_NAME="isaflow"
BUN="/home/hein/.bun/bin/bun"

echo "=== Deploying IsaFlow ==="

# 1. Build locally with bun
echo "Installing dependencies..."
cd "$REPO_DIR"
$BUN install

echo "Building production bundle..."
NODE_ENV=production $BUN run build

# 2. Deploy standalone output (includes all deps, no npm install needed)
echo "Syncing standalone build..."
sudo -u velo bash -c "mkdir -p $DEPLOY_DIR"

# Standalone server + bundled node_modules
sudo rsync -a --delete \
  --exclude=.env.local \
  "$REPO_DIR/.next/standalone/" "$DEPLOY_DIR/"

# Static assets (not included in standalone by default)
sudo rsync -a --delete \

# PRD: ISAFlow Admin Platform

## Overview

A centralised back-office platform for managing ISAFlow as a SaaS business. Provides ISAFlow staff with full visibility and control over companies, users, subscriptions, billing, support, and internal admin tools — all from a single dashboard at `/admin`.

This is the **business management layer** that sits above the accounting product. It is separate from the per-company accounting UI and is only accessible to ISAFlow staff (super_admin role).

## Problem

ISAFlow currently has no centralised way to:

1. View and manage all customer companies from one place
2. Manage users across companies (add, remove, change roles, reset passwords)
3. Track subscriptions, payments, and revenue
4. Control feature access per plan tier
5. Run admin tools (Sage auto-import, data migrations, bulk operations)
6. Monitor platform health (active users, storage, API usage)
7. Handle customer support without logging into individual companies
8. Enforce compliance (POPIA data exports, account deactivation)

Everything is currently done via direct database access or one-off scripts.

## Target Users

- ISAFlow founders / executives (business metrics, revenue)
- ISAFlow support staff (company management, user issues)
- ISAFlow developers (admin tools, diagnostics)

## Architecture

### Deployment: Separate App on `admin.isaflow.co.za`

The admin platform is a **separate Next.js application** deployed to its own subdomain. It shares the same Neon database as the customer app but has its own codebase, deployment pipeline, and auth enforcement.

**Why separate:**
- Customer JS bundle never includes admin code (smaller, more secure)
- Separate deployment — admin changes don't risk breaking the customer app
- Enforced 2FA, IP whitelist possible at the infrastructure level
- Customers can't discover admin routes exist
- Own rate limits, logging, CSP headers

**Repo structure:**
```
isaflow-admin/                    # Separate repo (or monorepo apps/admin)
  pages/
    index.tsx                     # Dashboard
    companies/                    # Company management
    users/                        # User management
    billing/                      # Subscriptions, invoices, plans
    tools/                        # Sage import, migrations, announcements
    audit.tsx                     # Audit trail
    settings.tsx                  # Platform settings
    api/                          # All API routes
  src/
    modules/admin/                # Admin services
    lib/                          # Shared DB connection (same Neon DB)
    components/admin/             # Admin UI components
```

**Infrastructure:**
```
admin.isaflow.co.za  → Vercel/Cloudflare (separate project)
app.isaflow.co.za    → Vercel/Cloudflare (customer app — unchanged)
                        ↘ Same Neon PostgreSQL database ↙
```

**Auth:** Same `users` table and JWT system. Admin app rejects any user without `super_admin` role at the middleware level. Session cookies scoped to `admin.isaflow.co.za` domain.

### Routes

```
admin.isaflow.co.za/                          → Dashboard
admin.isaflow.co.za/companies                 → Company management
admin.isaflow.co.za/companies/[id]            → Company detail + actions
admin.isaflow.co.za/users                     → User management
admin.isaflow.co.za/users/[id]                → User detail + actions
admin.isaflow.co.za/billing                   → Billing & subscriptions
admin.isaflow.co.za/billing/plans             → Plan management
admin.isaflow.co.za/billing/invoices          → Invoice history
admin.isaflow.co.za/tools                     → Admin tools
admin.isaflow.co.za/tools/sage-import         → Sage auto-import
admin.isaflow.co.za/tools/migrations          → Run migrations for companies
admin.isaflow.co.za/tools/announcements       → System-wide announcements
admin.isaflow.co.za/audit                     → Audit trail & activity logs
admin.isaflow.co.za/settings                  → Platform settings

admin.isaflow.co.za/api/*                     → All admin API routes
```

All routes require `super_admin` role. Unauthenticated requests redirect to login.

---

## Phase 1: Core Platform (MVP)

### 1.1 Admin Dashboard

**Route:** `/admin`

**Features:**
- KPI cards: Total companies, active companies (last 30 days), total users, MRR, ARR
- Revenue chart (monthly, last 12 months)
- New signups chart (weekly, last 3 months)
- Recent activity feed (last 50 events: signups, logins, subscription changes)
- Quick actions: Add company, add user, search

**API:** `GET /api/admin/dashboard-stats`

### 1.2 Company Management

**Route:** `/admin/companies`

**List view:**
- Searchable, sortable table of all companies
- Columns: Name, Plan, Status (active/suspended/trial), Users count, MRR, Created, Last active
- Filters: Plan tier, status, created date range, activity
- Bulk actions: Suspend, activate, change plan
- Export to CSV

**Detail view:** `/admin/companies/[id]`

- Company info card (name, registration, tax number, address, created date)
- Edit company details inline
- Subscription card (current plan, billing cycle, next invoice, payment method)
- Users tab: list of all users in this company with roles
- Activity tab: recent logins, transactions, API calls
- Storage tab: database size, document count, attachment size
- Sage data tab: if migrated from Sage, show migration session details
- Actions:
  - Suspend company (blocks all logins, preserves data)
  - Reactivate company
  - Change plan tier
  - Add/remove users
  - Reset company data (dangerous, requires confirmation)
  - Export company data (POPIA compliance)
  - Delete company (soft delete, 30-day retention)
  - Impersonate (login as company admin for support — audited)

**Database:**

```sql
-- Extend existing companies table
ALTER TABLE companies ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS plan_id UUID REFERENCES plans(id);
ALTER TABLE companies ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'active'
  CHECK (status IN ('trial', 'active', 'suspended', 'cancelled', 'deleted'));
ALTER TABLE companies ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS trial_ends_at TIMESTAMPTZ;
ALTER TABLE companies ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS suspended_at TIMESTAMPTZ;
ALTER TABLE companies ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS suspended_reason TEXT;
ALTER TABLE companies ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS billing_email VARCHAR(255);
ALTER TABLE companies ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS billing_contact VARCHAR(255);
ALTER TABLE companies ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS stripe_customer_id VARCHAR(255);
ALTER TABLE companies ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS metadata JSONB DEFAULT '{}';
```

**API:**
- `GET /api/admin/companies` — list with filters, pagination
- `GET /api/admin/companies/[id]` — detail
- `PATCH /api/admin/companies/[id]` — update
- `POST /api/admin/companies/[id]/suspend` — suspend
- `POST /api/admin/companies/[id]/activate` — reactivate
- `POST /api/admin/companies/[id]/change-plan` — change subscription
- `POST /api/admin/companies/[id]/export-data` — POPIA data export
- `DELETE /api/admin/companies/[id]` — soft delete
- `POST /api/admin/companies/[id]/impersonate` — generate impersonation token

### 1.3 User Management

**Route:** `/admin/users`

**List view:**
- All users across all companies
- Columns: Name, Email, Role, Companies (count + names), Last login, Status, Created
- Filters: Role, active/inactive, company, last login range
- Search by name or email

**Detail view:** `/admin/users/[id]`

- Profile card (name, email, phone, role, created, last login)
- Companies tab: all companies this user belongs to, with role per company
- Sessions tab: active sessions, devices, IPs
- Activity tab: recent actions (logins, transactions, settings changes)
- Actions:
  - Edit profile
  - Change global role
  - Change company role
  - Reset password (sends reset email)
  - Force logout (invalidate all sessions)
  - Suspend user
  - Delete user
  - Add to company / remove from company

**Database:**

```sql
-- Extend existing users table
ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'active'
  CHECK (status IN ('active', 'suspended', 'deleted'));
ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS last_login_at TIMESTAMPTZ;
ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS last_login_ip VARCHAR(45);
ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS login_count INT DEFAULT 0;
ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS suspended_at TIMESTAMPTZ;
ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS suspended_reason TEXT;

-- Admin audit log
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS admin_audit_log (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  admin_user_id UUID NOT NULL,
  action VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  target_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, -- 'company', 'user', 'plan', 'system'
  target_id UUID,
  details JSONB DEFAULT '{}',
  ip_address VARCHAR(45),
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);
CREATE INDEX idx_admin_audit_admin ON admin_audit_log(admin_user_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_admin_audit_target ON admin_audit_log(target_type, target_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_admin_audit_created ON admin_audit_log(created_at DESC);
```

**API:**
- `GET /api/admin/users` — list with filters
- `GET /api/admin/users/[id]` — detail
- `PATCH /api/admin/users/[id]` — update
- `POST /api/admin/users/[id]/reset-password` — send reset email
- `POST /api/admin/users/[id]/force-logout` — invalidate sessions
- `POST /api/admin/users/[id]/suspend` — suspend
- `POST /api/admin/users/[id]/add-to-company` — assign to company with role
- `DELETE /api/admin/users/[id]/remove-from-company` — remove from company

---

## Phase 2: Billing & Subscriptions

### 2.1 Plan Management

**Route:** `/admin/billing/plans`

**Features:**
- CRUD subscription plans
- Plan fields: name, code, description, monthly_price, annual_price, features (JSONB), limits (max_users, max_companies, max_storage_gb, max_invoices_per_month)
- Feature flags per plan (e.g., payroll, multi-company, API access, bank feeds, document capture)
- Active/archived status

**Database:**

```sql
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS plans (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  code VARCHAR(50) UNIQUE NOT NULL, -- 'starter', 'professional', 'enterprise'
  name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  description TEXT,
  monthly_price_cents INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  annual_price_cents INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  currency VARCHAR(3) DEFAULT 'ZAR',
  features JSONB DEFAULT '{}',
  limits JSONB DEFAULT '{}',
  is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT true,
  display_order INT DEFAULT 0,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);
```

**Default plans:**

| Plan | Monthly | Annual | Users | Features |
|------|---------|--------|-------|----------|
| Starter | R299 | R2,990 | 1 | Core accounting, 1 company, invoicing, bank recon |
| Professional | R599 | R5,990 | 5 | + Payroll, multi-company, bank feeds, document capture |
| Enterprise | R1,499 | R14,990 | Unlimited | + API access, custom reports, priority support, SLA |

### 2.2 Subscription Management

**Route:** `/admin/billing`

**Features:**
- Overview: total MRR, ARR, churn rate, ARPU
- Subscription list: company, plan, status (active/past_due/cancelled), next billing date, payment method
- Change plan for any company
- Apply discounts / credits
- Cancel / pause subscriptions
- View payment history per company

**Database:**

```sql
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS subscriptions (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  company_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES companies(id),
  plan_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES plans(id),
  status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'active'
    CHECK (status IN ('trial', 'active', 'past_due', 'cancelled', 'paused')),
  billing_cycle VARCHAR(10) DEFAULT 'monthly' CHECK (billing_cycle IN ('monthly', 'annual')),
  current_period_start TIMESTAMPTZ,
  current_period_end TIMESTAMPTZ,
  cancel_at_period_end BOOLEAN DEFAULT false,
  cancelled_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  stripe_subscription_id VARCHAR(255),
  discount_percent INT DEFAULT 0,
  notes TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);
CREATE INDEX idx_subscriptions_company ON subscriptions(company_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_subscriptions_status ON subscriptions(status);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS invoices (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  company_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES companies(id),
  subscription_id UUID REFERENCES subscriptions(id),
  invoice_number VARCHAR(20) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'draft'
    CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'sent', 'paid', 'overdue', 'cancelled', 'credited')),
  subtotal_cents INT NOT NULL,
  tax_cents INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  total_cents INT NOT NULL,
  currency VARCHAR(3) DEFAULT 'ZAR',
  due_date DATE,
  paid_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  payment_method VARCHAR(50),
  stripe_invoice_id VARCHAR(255),
  line_items JSONB DEFAULT '[]',
  notes TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);
CREATE INDEX idx_invoices_company ON invoices(company_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_invoices_status ON invoices(status);
```

### 2.3 Payment Integration

**Provider:** Stripe (primary) + PayFast (SA fallback)

- Stripe for card payments, subscriptions, invoicing
- PayFast for SA bank payments (EFT, instant EFT)
- Webhook handlers for payment events
- Automatic invoice generation on subscription renewal
- Dunning: email reminders at 1, 3, 7 days overdue, suspend at 14 days

**API:**
- `GET /api/admin/billing/overview` — MRR, ARR, churn metrics
- `GET /api/admin/billing/subscriptions` — list
- `PATCH /api/admin/billing/subscriptions/[id]` — update
- `GET /api/admin/billing/invoices` — list
- `POST /api/admin/billing/invoices/[id]/send` — send to customer
- `POST /api/admin/billing/invoices/[id]/mark-paid` — manual payment recording
- `POST /api/webhooks/stripe` — Stripe webhook handler
- `POST /api/webhooks/payfast` — PayFast ITN handler

---

## Phase 3: Access Control & Feature Flags

### 3.1 Feature Flags

Control which features are available per plan and per company.

**Database:**

```sql
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS feature_flags (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  code VARCHAR(100) UNIQUE NOT NULL, -- 'payroll', 'multi_company', 'bank_feeds', 'api_access'
  name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
  description TEXT,
  is_global BOOLEAN DEFAULT false, -- if true, available to everyone
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS plan_features (
  plan_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES plans(id),
  feature_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES feature_flags(id),
  PRIMARY KEY (plan_id, feature_id)
);

-- Per-company overrides (enable a feature not in their plan, or disable one that is)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS company_feature_overrides (
  company_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES companies(id),
  feature_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES feature_flags(id),
  enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL,
  reason TEXT,
  set_by UUID NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
  PRIMARY KEY (company_id, feature_id)
);
```

**Default feature flags:**

| Code | Name | Starter | Pro | Enterprise |
|------|------|---------|-----|------------|
| `core_accounting` | Core Accounting (GL, AR, AP) | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| `invoicing` | Customer Invoicing | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| `bank_recon` | Bank Reconciliation | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| `bank_feeds` | Automatic Bank Feeds | No | Yes | Yes |
| `payroll` | Payroll Module | No | Yes | Yes |
| `multi_company` | Multiple Companies | No | Yes | Yes |
| `document_capture` | Document Capture / OCR | No | Yes | Yes |
| `api_access` | REST API Access | No | No | Yes |
| `custom_reports` | Custom Report Builder | No | No | Yes |
| `group_consolidation` | Group Consolidation | No | No | Yes |
| `sage_auto_import` | Sage Auto-Import (admin) | Admin | Admin | Admin |
| `priority_support` | Priority Support | No | No | Yes |

### 3.2 Feature Gate Middleware

```typescript
// Usage in API routes:
export default withCompany(withFeature('payroll')(withErrorHandler(handler)));

// Usage in UI:
const { hasFeature } = useFeatureFlags();
if (!hasFeature('bank_feeds')) return <UpgradePrompt feature="bank_feeds" />;
```

**API:**
- `GET /api/admin/features` — list all feature flags
- `PATCH /api/admin/features/[id]` — update
- `GET /api/admin/companies/[id]/features` — company's effective features
- `POST /api/admin/companies/[id]/features/override` — set override

---

## Phase 4: Admin Tools

### 4.1 Sage Auto-Import (Relocated)

Move the existing `/accounting/migration/sage-auto` functionality to `/admin/tools/sage-import`.

The admin logs into the customer's Sage account (with their permission), pulls all data, and pushes it directly into the customer's ISAFlow company — all without the customer needing to touch CSV files.

**Flow:**
1. Admin selects target company from dropdown
2. Admin opens Sage in a popup, logs in with the customer's credentials (shared by customer)
3. Clicks "Pull All Data" — accounts, customers, suppliers, invoices flow in
4. Admin reviews mapped data
5. Clicks "Import into [Company Name]" — data written to the target company

### 4.2 Bulk Migration Tool

**Route:** `/admin/tools/migrations`

Run the migration wizard on behalf of any company. Upload CSVs and import directly.

### 4.3 System Announcements

**Route:** `/admin/tools/announcements`

Create banner notifications shown to all users or specific companies.

**Database:**

```sql
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS system_announcements (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  title VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
  message TEXT NOT NULL,
  type VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'info' CHECK (type IN ('info', 'warning', 'maintenance', 'feature')),
  target VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'all' CHECK (target IN ('all', 'plan', 'company')),
  target_ids UUID[] DEFAULT '{}',
  starts_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
  ends_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  is_dismissible BOOLEAN DEFAULT true,
  created_by UUID NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);
```

### 4.4 Company Impersonation

Admin can "login as" any company for support purposes. Creates a time-limited impersonation token (30 min), logs every action to admin_audit_log. Visible indicator in the UI: "You are viewing as [Company Name] — Exit".

### 4.5 Data Export (POPIA Compliance)

Export all data for a company as a ZIP file containing:
- Company profile (JSON)
- Chart of accounts (CSV)
- All customers and suppliers (CSV)
- All invoices (CSV)
- All journal entries (CSV)
- All bank transactions (CSV)
- All documents/attachments (files)

Required for POPIA Subject Access Requests.

---

## Phase 5: Monitoring & Analytics

### 5.1 Platform Health Dashboard

**Route:** `/admin` (widgets)

- Active users (real-time, last 24h, last 7d)
- API response times (p50, p95, p99)
- Error rate (last 24h)
- Database size per company
- Uptime history

### 5.2 Usage Analytics

**Route:** `/admin/analytics`

- Most used features (page views, API calls per feature)
- User engagement (DAU, WAU, MAU, stickiness)
- Feature adoption rates per plan
- Churn prediction signals (inactive users, declining usage)
- Revenue per feature (which features drive upgrades)

### 5.3 Audit Trail

**Route:** `/admin/audit`

- Filterable log of all admin actions
- Who did what, when, to whom
- Exportable for compliance

---

## Database Migrations

```
scripts/migrations/sql/
  260_admin_platform_plans.sql          # plans table + default plans

```

## Security

- All `/admin` routes gated by `super_admin` role at both API and UI level
- Impersonation creates a separate JWT with `impersonating: true` flag + original admin ID
- All admin actions logged to `admin_audit_log` with IP address
- Impersonation sessions expire after 30 minutes
- Password reset emails go to the user, not the admin
- Company data exports are generated async and delivered via secure download link
- Stripe webhook signature verification required
- No admin can delete their own account or remove their own super_admin role

---

## Implementation Priority

| Phase | Scope | Estimate |
|-------|-------|----------|
| **Phase 1** | Dashboard + Company management + User management + Audit log | Core |
| **Phase 2** | Plans + Subscriptions + Invoices + Stripe/PayFast integration | Revenue |
| **Phase 3** | Feature flags + Feature gate middleware + Upgrade prompts | Monetisation |
| **Phase 4** | Admin tools (Sage import, bulk migration, announcements, impersonation, POPIA export) | Operations |
| **Phase 5** | Analytics + Health monitoring + Churn signals | Growth |

---

## Success Criteria

1. ISAFlow staff can onboard a new customer (create company, add users, assign plan) in under 2 minutes
2. All admin actions are audited with who, what, when, and IP
3. Revenue metrics (MRR, ARR, churn) are visible on the admin dashboard
4. Any customer's data can be exported for POPIA compliance in one click
5. Feature gating prevents access to premium features without the right plan
6. Sage auto-import can be run by ISAFlow staff on behalf of any customer
7. Customer support can impersonate a company to diagnose issues without asking for screenshots

# Admin Module

Platform administration for ISAFlow SaaS operations — company management, user management, billing, feature flags, and system analytics.

## Services (12)

| Service | Purpose |
|---------|---------|
| `adminCompanyService.ts` | Company CRUD, suspension, metadata management |
| `adminUserService.ts` | Platform user management, role assignment |
| `adminDashboardService.ts` | System-wide metrics and KPIs |
| `analyticsService.ts` | Usage analytics, company activity tracking |
| `announcementService.ts` | System-wide announcements to all users |
| `auditService.ts` | Admin-level audit logging (separate from accounting audit) |
| `billingService.ts` | Subscription management, plan assignment |
| `dataExportService.ts` | Platform data export for compliance |
| `featureFlagService.ts` | Feature flag management, per-company feature gating |
| `impersonationService.ts` | Admin impersonation of company users |
| `invoiceService.ts` | Platform billing invoice generation |
| `planService.ts` | Subscription plan CRUD (Starter, Professional, Enterprise) |

## Middleware

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `withAdmin.ts` | Admin role guard — restricts to super_admin users |
| `withFeature.ts` | Feature flag gate — checks company has access to feature |

## Key Rules

- All admin APIs live under `pages/api/admin/`
- Admin middleware uses `withAdmin()` (NOT `withCompany()`)
- Admin pages at `pages/admin/`
- Separate from accounting module — different auth scope
- Feature flags stored in `platform_features` table
- Plans stored in `platform_plans` table

-- Migration 261: Admin Platform — Plans table
-- Stores subscription plan definitions for the ISAFlow Admin Platform.
-- Plans control feature access and billing amounts per company.

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS plans (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  code VARCHAR(50) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  description TEXT,
  monthly_price_cents INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  annual_price_cents INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  currency VARCHAR(3) DEFAULT 'ZAR',
  features JSONB DEFAULT '{}',
  limits JSONB DEFAULT '{}',
  is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT true,
  display_order INT DEFAULT 0,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- Starter: R299/mo, R2990/yr — 1 user, core accounting + invoicing
INSERT INTO plans (code, name, description, monthly_price_cents, annual_price_cents, currency, limits, display_order)
VALUES (
  'starter',
  'Starter',
  'Core accounting and invoicing for sole traders and micro businesses.',
  29900,
  299000,
  'ZAR',
  '{"max_users": 1, "max_companies": 1}',
  1
)
ON CONFLICT (code) DO NOTHING;

-- Professional: R599/mo, R5990/yr — 5 users, + payroll, multi-company, bank feeds, document capture
INSERT INTO plans (code, name, description, monthly_price_cents, annual_price_cents, currency, limits, display_order)
VALUES (
  'professional',
  'Professional',
  'Full-featured accounting with payroll, bank feeds, and document capture for growing businesses.',
  59900,
  599000,
  'ZAR',
  '{"max_users": 5, "max_companies": 3}',
  2
)
ON CONFLICT (code) DO NOTHING;

-- Enterprise: R1499/mo, R14990/yr — unlimited users, + API, custom reports, priority support
INSERT INTO plans (code, name, description, monthly_price_cents, annual_price_cents, currency, limits, display_order)
VALUES (
  'enterprise',
  'Enterprise',
  'Unlimited users, API access, custom reports, group consolidation, and priority support.',
  149900,
  1499000,
  'ZAR',
  '{"max_users": null, "max_companies": null}',
  3
)
ON CONFLICT (code) DO NOTHING;

-- Migration 262: Admin Platform — Subscriptions and admin invoices
-- subscriptions tracks each company's active plan and billing cycle.
-- admin_invoices is intentionally prefixed to avoid conflict with the
-- accounting-module invoices table.

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS subscriptions (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  company_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES companies(id),
  plan_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES plans(id),
  status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('trial', 'active', 'past_due', 'cancelled', 'paused')),
  billing_cycle VARCHAR(10) DEFAULT 'monthly' CHECK (billing_cycle IN ('monthly', 'annual')),
  current_period_start TIMESTAMPTZ,
  current_period_end TIMESTAMPTZ,
  cancel_at_period_end BOOLEAN DEFAULT false,
  cancelled_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  stripe_subscription_id VARCHAR(255),
  discount_percent INT DEFAULT 0,
  notes TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_subscriptions_company ON subscriptions(company_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_subscriptions_status ON subscriptions(status);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS admin_invoices (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  company_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES companies(id),
  subscription_id UUID REFERENCES subscriptions(id),
  invoice_number VARCHAR(20) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'sent', 'paid', 'overdue', 'cancelled', 'credited')),
  subtotal_cents INT NOT NULL,
  tax_cents INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  total_cents INT NOT NULL,
  currency VARCHAR(3) DEFAULT 'ZAR',
  due_date DATE,
  paid_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  payment_method VARCHAR(50),
  stripe_invoice_id VARCHAR(255),
  line_items JSONB DEFAULT '[]',
  notes TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_admin_invoices_company ON admin_invoices(company_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_admin_invoices_status ON admin_invoices(status);

-- Migration 263: Admin Platform — Feature flags, plan features, and company overrides
-- feature_flags defines the available features in the system.
-- plan_features links features to plans (what each plan includes by default).
-- company_feature_overrides allows per-company exceptions above or below their plan.

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS feature_flags (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  code VARCHAR(100) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
  description TEXT,
  is_global BOOLEAN DEFAULT false,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS plan_features (
  plan_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES plans(id),
  feature_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES feature_flags(id),
  PRIMARY KEY (plan_id, feature_id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS company_feature_overrides (
  company_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES companies(id),
  feature_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES feature_flags(id),
  enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL,
  reason TEXT,
  set_by UUID NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
  PRIMARY KEY (company_id, feature_id)
);

-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Seed feature flags
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------

-- Global features: included for every plan (and every company automatically)
INSERT INTO feature_flags (code, name, description, is_global)
VALUES
  ('core_accounting',    'Core Accounting',      'General ledger, chart of accounts, journal entries',    true),
  ('invoicing',          'Invoicing',             'Customer invoices, credit notes, and statements',       true),
  ('bank_recon',         'Bank Reconciliation',  'Manual bank reconciliation against bank statements',    true)
ON CONFLICT (code) DO NOTHING;

-- Non-global features: available only on specific plans
INSERT INTO feature_flags (code, name, description, is_global)
VALUES
  ('bank_feeds',            'Bank Feeds',             'Automatic bank transaction import via open-banking feeds', false),
  ('payroll',               'Payroll',                'Full payroll processing, PAYE, UIF, and SDL',              false),
  ('multi_company',         'Multi-Company',          'Manage more than one company under a single account',      false),
  ('document_capture',      'Document Capture',       'OCR-based upload and extraction of supplier invoices',     false),
  ('api_access',            'API Access',             'REST API access for integrations and automations',         false),
  ('custom_reports',        'Custom Reports',         'Build and save custom financial report layouts',           false),
  ('group_consolidation',   'Group Consolidation',    'Consolidated financial statements across group entities',  false),
  ('priority_support',      'Priority Support',       'Dedicated support queue with SLA guarantees',              false)
ON CONFLICT (code) DO NOTHING;

-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Link features to plans
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------

-- Starter: global features only (core_accounting, invoicing, bank_recon)
-- Global features are implicit, but we still link them explicitly for clarity.
INSERT INTO plan_features (plan_id, feature_id)
SELECT p.id, f.id
FROM plans p, feature_flags f
WHERE p.code = 'starter'
  AND f.code IN ('core_accounting', 'invoicing', 'bank_recon')
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;

-- Professional: all Starter features + bank_feeds, payroll, multi_company, document_capture
INSERT INTO plan_features (plan_id, feature_id)
SELECT p.id, f.id
FROM plans p, feature_flags f
WHERE p.code = 'professional'
  AND f.code IN (
    'core_accounting', 'invoicing', 'bank_recon',
    'bank_feeds', 'payroll', 'multi_company', 'document_capture'
  )
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;

-- Enterprise: all Professional features + api_access, custom_reports, group_consolidation, priority_support
INSERT INTO plan_features (plan_id, feature_id)
SELECT p.id, f.id
FROM plans p, feature_flags f
WHERE p.code = 'enterprise'
  AND f.code IN (
    'core_accounting', 'invoicing', 'bank_recon',
    'bank_feeds', 'payroll', 'multi_company', 'document_capture',
    'api_access', 'custom_reports', 'group_consolidation', 'priority_support'
  )
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;

-- Migration 265: Admin Platform — System announcements
-- Allows ISAFlow admins to broadcast messages to all companies, specific plans,
-- or individual companies (maintenance windows, new features, warnings).

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS system_announcements (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  title VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
  message TEXT NOT NULL,
  type VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'info' CHECK (type IN ('info', 'warning', 'maintenance', 'feature')),
  target VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'all' CHECK (target IN ('all', 'plan', 'company')),
  target_ids UUID[] DEFAULT '{}',
  starts_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
  ends_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  is_dismissible BOOLEAN DEFAULT true,
  created_by UUID NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

## ISAFlow Admin/Business Management Section — Full Report

### Planning Document

`/home/hein/Workspace/IsaFlow/PRD-ADMIN-PLATFORM.md`

A complete, detailed PRD exists covering all five phases of the admin platform: Dashboard, Company/User Management (Phase 1), Billing and Subscriptions (Phase 2), Feature Flags (Phase 3), Admin Tools (Phase 4), and Analytics (Phase 5). The architecture note says this was originally intended to be a separate app on `admin.isaflow.co.za`, but the implementation landed inside the main app under `pages/admin/`.

---

### What Is Fully Implemented

The implementation is extensive and covers almost everything in the PRD.

#### Admin Pages (`/home/hein/Workspace/IsaFlow/pages/admin/`)

| File | Status |
|------|--------|
| `index.tsx` | Dashboard with KPI cards, platform health widget, and recent activity feed |

#### API Routes (`/home/hein/Workspace/IsaFlow/pages/api/admin/`)

All routes are wrapped with `withAdmin` (requires `super_admin` role):

- `dashboard-stats.ts`

- `users.ts`, `users/[id].ts`, `users/[id]/add-to-company.ts`, `users/[id]/force-logout.ts`, `users/[id]/remove-from-company.ts`, `users/[id]/reset-password.ts`, `users/[id]/suspend.ts`
- `billing/overview.ts`, `billing/plans.ts`, `billing/plans/[id].ts`, `billing/subscriptions.ts`, `billing/subscriptions/[id].ts`, `billing/subscriptions/[id]/cancel.ts`, `billing/invoices.ts`, `billing/invoices/[id]/mark-paid.ts`, `billing/invoices/[id]/send.ts`

#### Services (`/home/hein/Workspace/IsaFlow/src/modules/admin/services/`)

12 services, all fully implemented:

- `adminDashboardService.ts` — parallel queries for company stats, user stats, MRR/ARR, signup counts, recent activity
- `adminCompanyService.ts` — `listCompanies`, `getCompanyDetail`, `updateCompany`, `suspendCompany`, `activateCompany`, `deleteCompany` (soft), `getCompanyUsers`
- `adminUserService.ts` — platform-wide user management
- `billingService.ts` — `getBillingOverview`, `listSubscriptions`, `getSubscription`, `createSubscription`, `updateSubscription`, `cancelSubscription`
- `planService.ts` — `listPlans`, `getPlan`, `createPlan`, `updatePlan`, `archivePlan`

#### Middleware (`/home/hein/Workspace/IsaFlow/src/modules/admin/middleware/`)

- `withAdmin.ts` — chains `withAuth` + `withRole('super_admin')` + `withErrorHandler`
- `withFeature.ts` — feature gate for customer-facing API routes; calls `hasFeature(companyId, featureCode)` and returns `403` with `{ upgrade_required: true }` if not allowed

#### Components (`/home/hein/Workspace/IsaFlow/src/components/admin/`)

- `AdminLayout.tsx` — enforces `super_admin` role at render time, redirects to `/login` otherwise
- `AdminNav.tsx` — sidebar navigation
- `StatsCard.tsx` — KPI card
- `FeatureGate.tsx` — UI-level feature gating
- `ImpersonationBanner.tsx` — "Viewing as [Company]" banner
- `AnnouncementModal.tsx` — announcement display
- `ConfirmModal.tsx` — destructive action confirmation
- `UpgradePrompt.tsx` — upgrade prompt for gated features

#### Types (`/home/hein/Workspace/IsaFlow/src/modules/admin/types/admin.types.ts`)

Complete TypeScript interfaces for all entities: `AdminCompanyListItem`, `AdminCompanyDetail`, `AdminUserListItem`, `AdminUserDetail`, `DashboardStats`, `AuditLogEntry`, `Plan`, `SubscriptionListItem`, `InvoiceListItem`, `BillingOverview`, `FeatureFlag`, `CompanyEffectiveFeature`, `Announcement`, `PlatformHealth`, `UsageAnalytics`, `PlatformSettings`.

---

### Database Migrations (`/home/hein/Workspace/IsaFlow/scripts/migrations/sql/`)

All admin platform migrations are present and implemented:

| File | Contents |
|------|----------|
| `261_admin_platform_plans.sql` | `plans` table + seed data for Starter (R299/mo), Professional (R599/mo), Enterprise (R1,499/mo) |
| `262_admin_platform_subscriptions.sql` | `subscriptions` table + `admin_invoices` table (prefixed to avoid collision with accounting module's invoices) |
| `263_admin_platform_features.sql` | `feature_flags`, `plan_features`, `company_feature_overrides` tables + seed data for 11 feature flags with plan assignments |
| `264_admin_platform_audit.sql` | `admin_audit_log` table with indexes |
| `265_admin_platform_announcements.sql` | `system_announcements` table |
| `266_admin_platform_company_user_ext.sql` | `ALTER TABLE companies` adds `plan_id`, `status`, `trial_ends_at`, `suspended_at`, `suspended_reason`, `billing_email`, `billing_contact`, `stripe_customer_id`, `metadata`; `ALTER TABLE users` adds `status`, `last_login_ip`, `login_count`, `suspended_at`, `suspended_reason` |

---

### Notable Design Decisions

1. The billing invoice table is named `admin_invoices` (not `invoices`) to avoid conflict with the accounting module's own `invoices` table.
2. Impersonation uses a separate short-lived JWT (30 min) with `impersonating: true` flag, signed with the same `JWT_SECRET`.
3. Feature gating operates at three levels: global (everyone gets it), plan (linked via `plan_features`), and company override (`company_feature_overrides`). Overrides always win.
4. The admin section is embedded inside the main Next.js app at `/admin` rather than the originally planned separate subdomain deployment. The `super_admin` role check happens at both the `AdminLayout` component level and the `withAdmin` API middleware level.

---

### What Is NOT Yet Implemented (per PRD gaps)

Based on the PRD vs actual files:

- **Stripe/PayFast webhooks** — no `pages/api/webhooks/stripe.ts` or `pages/api/webhooks/payfast.ts` found. Payment gateway integration (dunning, auto-invoicing) is not implemented.
- **Sage Auto-Import** (`/admin/tools/sage-import`) — the tools directory only has `index.tsx` and `announcements.tsx`. The Sage import relocation from `/accounting/migration/sage-auto` to the admin tools section is not done.
- **Bulk Migration Tool** (`/admin/tools/migrations`) — not present as an admin tool page.
- **Analytics page** exists as a page file but the PRD's churn prediction signals and full engagement metrics may not be fully built out.
- **`/api/admin/companies/[id]/change-plan.ts`** — not in the file listing (only `activate`, `suspend`, `export-data`, `features`, `impersonate`, `users` are present). Changing a company's plan via the admin is not exposed as a dedicated API route.

---

## ISAFlow Admin/Business Management Section — Full Report

### Planning Document

`/home/hein/Workspace/IsaFlow/PRD-ADMIN-PLATFORM.md`

A complete, detailed PRD exists covering all five phases of the admin platform: Dashboard, Company/User Management (Phase 1), Billing and Subscriptions (Phase 2), Feature Flags (Phase 3), Admin Tools (Phase 4), and Analytics (Phase 5). The architecture note says this was originally intended to be a separate app on `admin.isaflow.co.za`, but the implementation landed inside the main app under `pages/admin/`.

---

### What Is Fully Implemented

The implementation is extensive and covers almost everything in the PRD.

#### Admin Pages (`/home/hein/Workspace/IsaFlow/pages/admin/`)

| File | Status |
|------|--------|
| `index.tsx` | Dashboard with KPI cards, platform health widget, and recent activity feed |
| `companies/index.tsx` | Searchable/sortable/paginated company list with status filter |
| `companies/[id].tsx` | Company detail with info tab, users tab, suspend/activate/delete actions |
| `users/index.tsx` | Platform-wide user list |
| `users/[id].tsx` | User detail with actions |
| `billing/index.tsx` | Billing overview — MRR, ARR, churn rate, ARPU, recent subscriptions |
| `billing/plans.tsx` | Full CRUD for plans (create, edit, archive) in a modal form |
| `billing/subscriptions.tsx` | Subscription list and management |
| `billing/invoices.tsx` | Invoice list with mark-paid and send actions |
| `features.tsx` | Feature flag list with inline editing (name, description, is_global toggle) |
| `analytics.tsx` | Usage analytics page |
| `audit.tsx` | Audit trail page |
| `settings.tsx` | Platform settings page |
| `tools/index.tsx` | Admin tools index |
| `tools/announcements.tsx` | System announcements management |
| `components.tsx` | Component library/playground page |

#### API Routes (`/home/hein/Workspace/IsaFlow/pages/api/admin/`)

All routes are wrapped with `withAdmin` (requires `super_admin` role):

- `dashboard-stats.ts`
- `companies.ts`, `companies/[id].ts`, `companies/[id]/activate.ts`, `companies/[id]/suspend.ts`, `companies/[id]/export-data.ts`, `companies/[id]/features.ts`, `companies/[id]/impersonate.ts`, `companies/[id]/users.ts`
- `users.ts`, `users/[id].ts`, `users/[id]/add-to-company.ts`, `users/[id]/force-logout.ts`, `users/[id]/remove-from-company.ts`, `users/[id]/reset-password.ts`, `users/[id]/suspend.ts`
- `billing/overview.ts`, `billing/plans.ts`, `billing/plans/[id].ts`, `billing/subscriptions.ts`, `billing/subscriptions/[id].ts`, `billing/subscriptions/[id]/cancel.ts`, `billing/invoices.ts`, `billing/invoices/[id]/mark-paid.ts`, `billing/invoices/[id]/send.ts`
- `features.ts`, `features/[id].ts`
- `analytics/health.ts`, `analytics/usage.ts`
- `audit.ts`, `announcements.ts`, `announcements/[id].ts`, `settings.ts`

#### Services (`/home/hein/Workspace/IsaFlow/src/modules/admin/services/`)

12 services, all fully implemented:

- `adminDashboardService.ts` — parallel queries for company stats, user stats, MRR/ARR, signup counts, recent activity
- `adminCompanyService.ts` — `listCompanies`, `getCompanyDetail`, `updateCompany`, `suspendCompany`, `activateCompany`, `deleteCompany` (soft), `getCompanyUsers`
- `adminUserService.ts` — platform-wide user management
- `billingService.ts` — `getBillingOverview`, `listSubscriptions`, `getSubscription`, `createSubscription`, `updateSubscription`, `cancelSubscription`
- `planService.ts` — `listPlans`, `getPlan`, `createPlan`, `updatePlan`, `archivePlan`
- `featureFlagService.ts` — `listFeatureFlags`, `getFeatureFlag`, `updateFeatureFlag`, `getCompanyEffectiveFeatures`, `setCompanyFeatureOverride`, `removeCompanyFeatureOverride`, `hasFeature`
- `impersonationService.ts` — 30-minute JWT-based impersonation tokens

- `auditService.ts` — admin audit log writes and queries

#### Middleware (`/home/hein/Workspace/IsaFlow/src/modules/admin/middleware/`)

- `withAdmin.ts` — chains `withAuth` + `withRole('super_admin')` + `withErrorHandler`

#### Components (`/home/hein/Workspace/IsaFlow/src/components/admin/`)

- `AdminLayout.tsx` — enforces `super_admin` role at render time, redirects to `/login` otherwise
- `AdminNav.tsx` — sidebar navigation
- `StatsCard.tsx` — KPI card
- `FeatureGate.tsx` — UI-level feature gating
- `ImpersonationBanner.tsx` — "Viewing as [Company]" banner

- `ConfirmModal.tsx` — destructive action confirmation

#### Types (`/home/hein/Workspace/IsaFlow/src/modules/admin/types/admin.types.ts`)

Complete TypeScript interfaces for all entities: `AdminCompanyListItem`, `AdminCompanyDetail`, `AdminUserListItem`, `AdminUserDetail`, `DashboardStats`, `AuditLogEntry`, `Plan`, `SubscriptionListItem`, `InvoiceListItem`, `BillingOverview`, `FeatureFlag`, `CompanyEffectiveFeature`, `Announcement`, `PlatformHealth`, `UsageAnalytics`, `PlatformSettings`.

---

### Database Migrations (`/home/hein/Workspace/IsaFlow/scripts/migrations/sql/`)

All admin platform migrations are present and implemented:

| File | Contents |
|------|----------|
| `261_admin_platform_plans.sql` | `plans` table + seed data for Starter (R299/mo), Professional (R599/mo), Enterprise (R1,499/mo) |
| `262_admin_platform_subscriptions.sql` | `subscriptions` table + `admin_invoices` table (prefixed to avoid collision with accounting module's invoices) |
| `263_admin_platform_features.sql` | `feature_flags`, `plan_features`, `company_feature_overrides` tables + seed data for 11 feature flags with plan assignments |
| `264_admin_platform_audit.sql` | `admin_audit_log` table with indexes |
| `265_admin_platform_announcements.sql` | `system_announcements` table |
| `266_admin_platform_company_user_ext.sql` | `ALTER TABLE companies` adds `plan_id`, `status`, `trial_ends_at`, `suspended_at`, `suspended_reason`, `billing_email`, `billing_contact`, `stripe_customer_id`, `metadata`; `ALTER TABLE users` adds `status`, `last_login_ip`, `login_count`, `suspended_at`, `suspended_reason` |

---

### Notable Design Decisions

1. The billing invoice table is named `admin_invoices` (not `invoices`) to avoid conflict with the accounting module's own `invoices` table.
2. Impersonation uses a separate short-lived JWT (30 min) with `impersonating: true` flag, signed with the same `JWT_SECRET`.
3. Feature gating operates at three levels: global (everyone gets it), plan (linked via `plan_features`), and company override (`company_feature_overrides`). Overrides always win.
4. The admin section is embedded inside the main Next.js app at `/admin` rather than the originally planned separate subdomain deployment. The `super_admin` role check happens at both the `AdminLayout` component level and the `withAdmin` API middleware level.

---

### What Is NOT Yet Implemented (per PRD gaps)

Based on the PRD vs actual files:

- **Stripe/PayFast webhooks** — no `pages/api/webhooks/stripe.ts` or `pages/api/webhooks/payfast.ts` found. Payment gateway integration (dunning, auto-invoicing) is not implemented.
- **Sage Auto-Import** (`/admin/tools/sage-import`) — the tools directory only has `index.tsx` and `announcements.tsx`. The Sage import relocation from `/accounting/migration/sage-auto` to the admin tools section is not done.
- **Bulk Migration Tool** (`/admin/tools/migrations`) — not present as an admin tool page.
- **Analytics page** exists as a page file but the PRD's churn prediction signals and full engagement metrics may not be fully built out.
- **`/api/admin/companies/[id]/change-plan.ts`** — not in the file listing (only `activate`, `suspend`, `export-data`, `features`, `impersonate`, `users` are present). Changing a company's plan via the admin is not exposed as a dedicated API route.

**Sage endpoint names (discovered 2026-04-02):**
Some use POST `GetWithFilter`, others use GET `Get`:

| Entity | Method | Endpoint | Notes |
|--------|--------|----------|-------|
| Company | GET | `/services/Company/Current` | Single object |
| Account | POST | `/services/Account/GetWithFilter` | FilterId=2, custom OrderBy |
| Customer | POST | `/services/Customer/GetWithFilter` | |
| Supplier | POST | `/services/Supplier/GetWithFilter` | |
| TaxInvoice (AR) | POST | `/services/TaxInvoice/GetWithFilter` | |
| SupplierInvoice (AP) | POST | `/services/SupplierInvoice/GetWithFilter` | |
| CustomerReceipt | POST | `/services/CustomerReceipt/GetWithFilter` | NOT "Receipt" |
| SupplierPayment | POST | `/services/SupplierPayment/GetWithFilter` | |
| CustomerReturn | POST | `/services/CustomerReturn/GetWithFilter` | NOT "CustomerNote" |
| SupplierReturn | POST | `/services/SupplierReturn/GetWithFilter` | |
| Item | POST | `/services/Item/GetWithFilter` | |
| TaxType | GET | `/services/TaxType/Get` | Returns array, NOT paginated |
| JournalEntry | GET | `/services/JournalEntry/Get` | Returns array, NOT paginated |
| BankTransaction | GET | `/services/BankTransaction/Get` | Returns array (can be 8000+) |
| BankAccount | POST | `/services/BankAccount/GetWithFilter` | Returns 500 on Brightsphere |

**Session timeout:** Sage sessions expire during long pulls. If endpoints start returning HTML (`<!DOCTYPE`), the session has expired — user must re-login.

**Why:** Sage sync is ISAFlow's primary customer onboarding path. Getting the endpoint names right saves significant debugging time.
**How to apply:** Use the correct endpoint names above. For browser automation pulls, use `evaluate_script` to run fetch calls in the Sage tab.

---
name: apiResponse wrapper shape
description: ISAFlow API responses wrap data in { data: { ... } } — always unwrap json.data.fieldName, not json.data directly
type: feedback
---

ISAFlow's `apiResponse.success(res, { session })` returns `{ data: { session: ... } }`.

**The bug:** Frontend code doing `setSession(json.data)` when it should be `setSession(json.data.session)`. When `session` is null, `json.data` is `{ session: null }` which is truthy — causes crash when accessing properties.

**Rule:** Always access the specific field: `json.data.session`, `json.data.records`, etc. Never pass `json.data` directly to state when it's an object wrapper.

**Why:** This bug caused the Migration Wizard to crash with "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'coa')" on production (2026-04-02). Fixed in `pages/accounting/migration/index.tsx`.
**How to apply:** When writing new pages that consume ISAFlow APIs, always destructure `json.data.specificField`.

---
name: Invite flow UX lessons
description: Invite page must go to register (not login), never pre-fill masked emails, auto-accept on register
type: feedback
---

When implementing invite/registration flows, follow these rules:

1. **New users should register, not sign in.** Primary CTA on invite page for non-logged-in users must be "Create Account & Join", not "Sign In". Sign In is secondary.

2. **Never pre-fill masked emails.** The invite API returns masked emails (e.g. `h***@domain`) for privacy. The register page must NOT use this as the email field value — it creates accounts with literal masked emails.

3. **Auto-accept invites on registration.** Pass the invite token from the register page to the register API. The API should accept the invite by token (not just email match) and set `onboarding_completed = true` + `ff_onboarding_done` cookie. User goes straight to dashboard.

4. **Auto-login after registration.** The register API sets the auth cookie so users don't need to sign in separately.

5. **Skip onboarding for invited users.** Users joining via invite don't need the "set up company" onboarding flow. The middleware checks `ff_onboarding_done` cookie.

**Why:** These were discovered through live browser testing on 2026-03-31. The masked email bug caused corrupted user records in production.
**How to apply:** Any future changes to auth/invite/register flows must preserve these behaviors.

---
name: Bank rules and smart categorize gotchas
description: Schema mismatches, suggestion state management, and auto-apply behavior for bank categorisation rules
type: feedback
---

**Schema:** `bank_categorisation_rules` table columns:
- `match_pattern` (NOT match_value — was renamed in migration 284)
- `supplier_id` is UUID (NOT integer — don't use `Number()` cast)
- `auto_create_entry`, `vat_code`, `description_template` added in migration 284

**Suggestion state management:** After running Smart Categorize or creating a rule:
- Must call `setRowSelections({})` to clear stale UI selections
- The `useEffect` that maps suggestions to `rowSelections` only applies to rows where `entityId` is not already set
- Without clearing, new suggestions from DB won't override stale frontend state

**Auto-apply on rule creation:** When a rule is created, the API immediately runs `applyRules()` for the current bank account. The frontend sends `bankAccountId` in the POST body. No separate "Smart Categorize" click needed.

**AI categorization timeout:** The `/api/accounting/smart-categorize` endpoint can hang when calling the AI API. The frontend uses a 15s `AbortController` timeout so the button doesn't freeze.

**Why:** These issues caused multiple bugs during 2026-03-31/04-01 testing — rules not saving, suggestions not displaying, button hanging.
**How to apply:** Check these when modifying bank transaction categorization or rule management.

#!/bin/bash
# Deploy IsaFlow App to Velocity Server (standalone build)
set -e

DEPLOY_DIR="/home/velo/isaflow"
REPO_DIR="/home/hein/Workspace/IsaFlow"
SERVICE_NAME="isaflow"
BUN="/home/hein/.bun/bin/bun"

echo "=== Deploying IsaFlow ==="

# 1. Build locally with bun
echo "Installing dependencies..."
cd "$REPO_DIR"
$BUN install

echo "Building production bundle..."
NODE_ENV=production $BUN run build

# 2. Deploy standalone output (includes all deps, no npm install needed)
echo "Syncing standalone build..."
sudo -u velo bash -c "mkdir -p $DEPLOY_DIR"

# Standalone server + bundled node_modules
sudo rsync -a --delete \
  --exclude=.env.local \
  "$REPO_DIR/.next/standalone/" "$DEPLOY_DIR/"

# Static assets (not included in standalone by default)
sudo rsync -a --delete \
  "$REPO_DIR/.next/static/" "$DEPLOY_DIR/.next/static/"

# Public folder (logo, icons, manifest, sw.js)
sudo rsync -a --delete \
  "$REPO_DIR/public/" "$DEPLOY_DIR/public/"

# Fix ownership
sudo chown -R velo:velo "$DEPLOY_DIR"

# 3. Copy env file if not exists
if [ ! -f "$DEPLOY_DIR/.env.local" ]; then
  echo "Creating .env.local..."
  sudo -u velo cp "$REPO_DIR/.env.local" "$DEPLOY_DIR/.env.local"
fi

# 4. Install/update systemd service
echo "Updating systemd service..."
sudo cp "$REPO_DIR/scripts/${SERVICE_NAME}.service" /etc/systemd/system/
sudo systemctl daemon-reload
sudo systemctl enable $SERVICE_NAME

# 5. Install nginx config if not exists
if [ ! -f /etc/nginx/sites-available/app-isaflow ]; then
  echo "Installing nginx config..."
  sudo cp "$REPO_DIR/scripts/nginx-app-isaflow" /etc/nginx/sites-available/app-isaflow
  sudo ln -sf /etc/nginx/sites-available/app-isaflow /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/app-isaflow
  sudo nginx -t && sudo systemctl reload nginx
fi

# 6. Restart service
echo "Restarting service..."
sudo systemctl restart $SERVICE_NAME

# 7. Check status
sleep 2
sudo systemctl status $SERVICE_NAME --no-pager | head -15

echo ""
echo "=== Deploy complete ==="
echo "App: https://app.isaflow.co.za"

# Neon Postgres connection string
DATABASE_URL=postgresql://user:password@host/dbname?sslmode=require

# JWT secret — generate with: openssl rand -base64 32
JWT_SECRET=CHANGE_ME_TO_A_STRONG_RANDOM_SECRET

# Environment
NODE_ENV=development

# Public app URL
NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL=http://localhost:3101

# PayFast Payment Gateway (sandbox defaults)
PAYFAST_MERCHANT_ID=YOUR_PAYFAST_MERCHANT_ID
PAYFAST_MERCHANT_KEY=YOUR_PAYFAST_MERCHANT_KEY

# Bank Feeds (Stitch / Investec Open Banking)

# Copy to .env.local and fill in real values

DATABASE_URL=postgresql://user:password@host/dbname?sslmode=require

# JWT secret — generate with: openssl rand -base64 32
JWT_SECRET=CHANGE_ME_TO_A_STRONG_RANDOM_SECRET

# Environment
NODE_ENV=development

# PayFast Payment Gateway (sandbox defaults)
PAYFAST_MERCHANT_ID=YOUR_PAYFAST_MERCHANT_ID
PAYFAST_MERCHANT_KEY=YOUR_PAYFAST_MERCHANT_KEY
PAYFAST_PASSPHRASE=

**Nginx** (`scripts/nginx-isaflow-landing`) — Added `admin.isaflow.co.za` to `server_name`

10. **Feature Flags** (/features) — Check feature list, toggle switches, edit inline
